clips.title: The story
paras: After the first part of Sunken Treasure, Doctor Draxlegauge lends you his Goggles of Gem Hunting and asks you to collect ten elven gems from the sea floor for Captain O'Breen, then bring the goggles back.

Down on the sea floor, the gems have lain so many years that they have hardened into thick stone. The power built into the goggles lets you find them regardless, and Doctor Draxlegauge is proud of the gnomish ingenuity behind them. He lends you the goggles so you can gather the lost gems for Captain O'Breen.

He would swim down himself, he says, but there is scientific work waiting for him on safe, dry land. He wants the goggles returned afterwards, sure that Captain O'Breen will put them to plenty of use.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.
A little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!
So borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, friend, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.
I'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How did the goggles work? Did everything function properly? Adjustments can be made if necessary.
Oh, and I'll need those goggles back when you're done. I am sure Captain O'Breen will have many uses for them later on.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most superb, friend! The Captain will be very pleased! And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!
